fasi.d: In this first stage we immerse ourselves in your needs and goals. We analyse the type of project and work closely with you to understand exactly what you want to achieve with your storefront.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to decorate a storefront in Biasca?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the size of the window, the type of graphics and the materials chosen. We prepare a personalised, free quote within 24/48h, with solutions suited both to the small village shop and to the company in the industrial zone.

faq.domanda: Do you also reach businesses outside the centre of Biasca?
faq.risposta: Yes. We serve the centre and all of Biasca, from residential neighbourhoods to the industrial zone, out to the nearby towns of the Riviera and the rest of Ticino. We handle the site visit and the installation ourselves, wherever your business is, with no surprise costs.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to install the decoration?
faq.risposta: Application usually takes four or five hours, but the timing varies with the complexity of the design and the size of the window. We arrange the work at the times that suit your business best, so it never disrupts your day.

faq.domanda: Can I decorate only part of the window, such as the logo or opening hours?
faq.risposta: Of course. We can apply just the logo, a slogan, the opening hours or a decorative band, for a targeted effect without covering the whole glass. It's a very popular option with boutiques, studios and shops of every kind.

faq.domanda: What materials do you use for storefront decoration?
faq.risposta: High-quality films and window graphics, resistant to UV rays and the weather. They keep their colours and sharpness over time, even when exposed to the sun and rain typical of Ticino's climate.

faq.domanda: Does the decoration withstand rain, sun and temperature swings?
faq.risposta: Yes. The materials are designed for outdoor exposure and keep looking flawless in every season, without fading or peeling.

faq.domanda: Can the window graphics be removed or updated in future?
faq.risposta: Yes. The films can be removed without damaging the glass and can be updated whenever you change a promotion, logo or seasonal display. Handy for anyone who wants to refresh their storefront several times a year.

faq.domanda: Do I need to prepare the window before application?
faq.risposta: We take care of everything. We carefully clean and degrease the glass before applying the graphics, so adhesion is perfect and long-lasting: there's nothing for you to do.
